source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the female reproductive system (PDF 77-79).

blocks.text: Zanana reproductive system gonads (ovaries), oviducts, uterus (rahim) aur vagina par mushtamil hai. Oviducts, uterus aur vagina ko zanana reproductive system ke accessory (madadgar) organs kehte hain.

Ovaries egg cells (ova ya oocytes) banati hain aur hormones chhorti hain. Do ovaries hain, uterus ke dono taraf ek ek. Anda-numa (oval) ovary 3-5 cm lambi aur 2-3 cm chauri hoti hai. Is mein bohat si nanhi theli jaisi banawatein hoti hain jinhein ovarian follicles kehte hain; yeh ovary ki functional units (kaam karne wali buniyadi ikaaiyan) hain. Follicles kachche andon (immature eggs) ki parwarish karte hain. Baligh aurat mein har mahine pakne wale follicles mein se ek apna egg cell bahar nikalta hai; is waqiye ko ovulation kehte hain. Ovulation ke baad phata hua follicle ek glandular banawat mein badal jata hai jise corpus luteum kehte hain.

Oviducts (jinhein fallopian tubes ya uterine tubes bhi kehte hain) do nalyan hain jo ovaries se uterus tak jati hain. Jab ovum pak jata hai to ovarian follicle aur ovary ki deewar phat kar use bahar nikalti hain. Ovum oviduct mein dakhil ho kar uterus ki taraf safar karta hai. Is harkat mein oviduct ki andaruni teh ke cilia (baal jaise ubhaar) madad dete hain. Ovum ka fertilization bhi oviduct hi mein hota hai, aur banne wala zygote oviduct mein rehte hue hi kai dafa mitosis se taqseem hota hai.

Dono oviducts ek khokhle aur muscular organ mein khulti hain jise uterus kehte hain. Is ke teen hisse hain: fundus, body aur cervix. Fundus oviducts ke surakhon se oopar wala gol hissa hai. Body uterus ka sab se bara hissa hai. Uterus ke neeche wale tang hisse ko cervix kehte hain; cervix ka surakh vagina mein khulta hai.

Uterus ki deewar teen tehon (layers) se bani hai. Perimetrium sab se bahar wali patli teh hai. Myometrium beech wali moti teh hai jo smooth muscles se bani hai. Endometrium andar wali spongy teh hai; is ki do tehein hain: basal layer aur functional layer. Basal layer mein stem cells hote hain jo functional layer ko dobara banate hain. Functional layer menstrual cycle mein moti hoti hai aur phir jhar jati hai. Hamal (pregnancy) mein yeh mazeed moti ho jati hai taa ke embryo is mein jur (implant ho) sake. Is ki khoon wali jagahein (vascular spaces) mil kar aapas mein jur jati hain aur placenta banati hain, jo embryo aur foetus ko oxygen aur ghiza deta hai.
Yeh 8-10 cm lambi patli deewar wali nali hai jo bahar se uterus ke cervix tak jati hai. Yeh bachche ki paidaish aur haiz ke khoon (menstrual flow) ke bahar aane ka raasta hai.

blocks.alt: Zanana tolidi aaza saamne se (tarash): naashpati jaisa uterus (rahim), oopar gumbad numa fundus, beech ki khali jagah ke gird uterus body, neeche patla ho kar cervix aur phir vagina; har oopari kone se aik oviduct (fallopian tube) bahar mur kar ungli jaisi fimbriae par khatam hoti hai, jo ovary ke paas hain; ovary aik ligament (bandhan) se rahim se bandhi hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Yeh uterus ka saamne ka manzar (anterior view) hai. Beech mein naashpati jaisa uterus: oopar gol fundus, beech mein uterus body, neeche tang cervix aur us ke neeche vagina. Har oopari kone se ek oviduct (fallopian tube) bahar ki taraf murti hai aur ungli jaisi fimbriae par khatam hoti hai, jo ovary ke qareeb hoti hain; fimbriae ovulation par nikla hua anda oviduct mein le aati hain.

Ovum banne ka amal aurat ki embryonic (janeen ki) nashonuma ke dauran hi shuru ho jata hai. Us waqt follicle mein maujood oogonia (2n) mitosis se taqseem ho kar primary oocytes (2n) banate hain. Yeh primary oocytes pehli meiotic division shuru karte hain magar prophase-I mein ruk jate hain, aur poore bachpan (kam az kam 10 se 14 saal) prophase-I hi mein rehte hain.

Puberty par ovary ke bohat se primary oocytes mein se sirf ek meiosis-I dobara shuru karta hai aur do na-barabar (dissimilar) haploid cells banata hai: bara cell secondary oocyte (1n) aur chhota cell first polar body (1n) kehlata hai. Secondary oocyte metaphase-II mein taqseem rok deta hai aur ovulation par ovary se nikal kar oviduct mein jata hai. Agar ovulate hone wale secondary oocyte ko sperm fertilize na kare to woh mar jata hai. Lekin agar sperm secondary oocyte se mil jaye to woh foran (oviduct mein) meiosis II mukammal karta hai aur do naye cells banata hai: ek bara ovum (1n) aur ek chhota second polar body (1n).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein likha hai “It released from the body” (yani secondary oocyte jism se nikalta hai). Yeh ghalat hai: ovulation par secondary oocyte ovary (phate hue Graafian follicle) se nikal kar oviduct mein jata hai, jism se bahar nahin.

blocks.alt: Waqt ki patiyon ke saath oopar se neeche silsila. Paidaish se pehle: oogonium (2n), mitosis, meiosis-I mein ruka primary oocyte (2n). Pati: bachpan, ovary ghair faal. Balooghat se menopause tak: primary oocyte (2n), meiosis-I se pehla polar body (n, mar jata hai) aur metaphase-II mein ruka secondary oocyte (n); secondary oocyte ovulate hota aur sperm se milta hai; fertilize ho to meiosis-II mukammal ho kar doosra polar body (n, mar jata hai) aur zygote (2n) banta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.5: Oogenesis (anda banna) (kitab ki Figure 17.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Diagram ko oopar se neeche parhein. Paidaish se pehle: oogonium (2n) mitosis se primary oocyte (2n) banata hai jo meiosis-I mein ruk jata hai. Bachpan mein ovary ghair faal (inactive) rehti hai. Puberty se menopause tak: primary oocyte meiosis-I se first polar body (n, mar jata hai) aur metaphase-II mein ruka secondary oocyte (n) banata hai; secondary oocyte ovulate hota hai aur sperm se milta hai; fertilize ho to meiosis-II mukammal ho kar second polar body (n, mar jata hai) aur zygote (2n) bante hain. Note: ek primary oocyte se sirf ek ovum banta hai, jabke spermatogenesis mein chaar sperms.

blocks.title: For Information: paidaish par follicles
blocks.text: Paidaish ke waqt aurat ki ovaries mein taqreeban 20 lakh (2 million) follicles hote hain, har ek mein ek primary oocyte.

blocks.prompt: Ovulation par ovary se asal mein kaunsa cell nikalta hai?
blocks.explanation: Secondary oocyte, jo metaphase-II mein ruka hota hai. Yeh sirf tab meiosis II mukammal kar ke ovum banta hai jab sperm is se mil jaye.

items: Ovaries (follicles, ovulation, corpus luteum); oviducts (cilia, fertilization yahin); uterus (fundus, body, cervix; perimetrium, myometrium, endometrium); vagina.
Endometrium: basal layer (stem cells) aur functional layer (har cycle mein moti ho kar jharti hai; hamal mein placenta banane mein hissa).
Oogenesis: oogonium (2n), primary oocyte (2n, prophase-I mein ruka), puberty par secondary oocyte (1n) + first polar body; fertilization par ovum (1n) + second polar body.
